security_audit.summary: All 34 static detections are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, relative documentation links, and homepage metadata. The skill contains no executable commands, network client behavior, or filesystem traversal logic. It also explicitly instructs agents to treat imported campaign data as untrusted and not follow embedded instructions.

remediation.issue: Static scanners misclassify Markdown syntax and relative links as execution and traversal patterns.
remediation.suggestion: Use scanner rules that distinguish Markdown code delimiters and documentation links from executable shell syntax and path handling.

remediation.issue: The skill accepts exported advertising reports as input.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the existing untrusted-input instruction and require confirmation before saving generated evidence files.

content.value_statement: Advertising teams need documented controls before campaigns spend budget on unsafe or irrelevant inventory. This skill organizes placement, network, and content-suitability exclusions with evidence for review.
actual_capabilities: Creates site, app, channel, and network exclusion recommendations from a supplied placements report.
Lists content-suitability tiers and sensitive-topic blocks that match stated brand-safety constraints.
Distinguishes measured placement findings from user-provided constraints in the exclusion plan.
References an existing audience exclusion set without recreating audience segments.
Packages exclusion decisions and rationales as A1 brand and placement safety evidence.
Marks evidence as Unknown and requests input when the placements report is missing.
limitations: Does not access ad platforms or export reports without user-provided data.
Does not create targeted audiences or audience suppression segments.
Does not calculate ROAS, score the account, or issue an A1 verdict.
Recommendations depend on the completeness and accuracy of supplied campaign data.

use_cases.title: Prepare a pre-launch safety plan
use_cases.description: Create exclusions and content controls before a new campaign begins spending.

use_cases.title: Review placement quality
use_cases.description: Turn an account placements report into documented placement and network exclusion recommendations.

use_cases.title: Package audit evidence
use_cases.description: Prepare a clear record of exclusions and rationale for a brand-safety review.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic exclusion plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build brand-safety exclusion lists for my campaign goal before launch. My platforms are [platforms].

prompt_templates.title: Apply stated safety rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Set placement, network, and content-suitability exclusions for [account]. Our constraints are [constraints].

prompt_templates.title: Review a placements report
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this placements report for [goal]. Recommend exclusions and label each item as measured or user-provided.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare auditor evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Package A1 brand and placement safety evidence from these placements and campaign exports: [paths or pasted data]. Do not issue a verdict.

output_examples.input: Review a placements report for a retail prospecting campaign with no news, politics, or user-generated content.
output: A1 evidence checklist with missing inputs

output_examples.input: Prepare exclusions without a placements report.
output: Requested input: placements report and campaign goal

best_practices: Provide the campaign goal, platforms, and written brand-safety constraints before requesting recommendations.
Supply a current placements report and label any business rules that override measured performance.
Review proposed exclusions with stakeholders before applying them or saving durable records.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a campaign export as a substitute for a placements report.
Do not ask this skill to create audience segments or determine the final A1 verdict.
Do not infer safety approval when required placement evidence is missing.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the campaign goal, platforms, brand-safety constraints, and a placements report when available.

faq.question: Can this skill access my ad account?
faq.answer: No. It works from data you provide and does not require account access.

faq.question: Does it create audience exclusions?
faq.answer: No. It references an existing audience exclusion set managed by the audience segment workflow.

faq.question: Can it approve a campaign for launch?
faq.answer: No. It prepares evidence and exclusions, while the auditor workflow issues the A1 assessment.

faq.question: What happens when the placements report is missing?
faq.answer: It marks qualified A1 evidence as Unknown and requests the report instead of inferring a safe list.

faq.question: Will it save results automatically?
faq.answer: No. It saves a reusable result only after user confirmation.
